verdict.rationale: The plugin-marketplace docs state that marketplaces provide version tracking and automatic updates, and the anthropics/skills repo can be registered as a Claude Code marketplace and its skills installed through it. Plugins carry a version in plugin.json, and the API side exposes optional skill versions plus a Skill Versions API. This covers the core of the story, but the auto-update claim is a single line with little detail. missing for 10: an explicit documented update command or a description of how and when auto-updates apply, and hands-on or independent corroboration that updates arrive without reinstalling.
